# Rule: next[i] = (sum of range-hexad values mod 3 + count of KRIV (0) in range-hexad) mod 3
# Note: This worked for most training observations but may need refinement

def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state[0])
    result = []
    for i in range(n):
        # Compute range-hexad: indices (i-3)%n, (i-2)%n, (i-1)%n, (i+1)%n, (i+2)%n, (i+3)%n
        indices = [(i-3)%n, (i-2)%n, (i-1)%n, (i+1)%n, (i+2)%n, (i+3)%n]
        values = [state[0][idx] for idx in indices]
        s = sum(values) % 3
        ck = values.count(0)
        next_val = (s + ck) % 3
        result.append(next_val)
    return [result]
